subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Represent the following signal in terms of step and
ramp functions
(a)
– (2/T) r (t +(T/2)) [u(t+(T/2)) - u(t)]
(b)
(2/T) r(t + (T/2)) [u(t + (T/2)) - u(t)]
(c)
(2/T) r (t + (T/2)) [u( t + (T/2)) + u(t)]
(d)
(-2/T) r(t + (T/2)) [u(t + (T/2)) + u(t)]
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-02 (Basic of Signal System).
